name: Asiana Airlines, Inc.
summary: Asiana Airlines, Inc. engages in air transportation business in South Korea and internationally. It operates through Air Transport, IT, Air Transport Support, and Others segments. The company engages in the carriage of passengers, cargo, and ancillary services related to the airline and travel industries; and provision of aircraft repair and maintenance, reservation, and IT and computer reservation brokerage services. It also involved in ground operation; financial business; and real estate and rental businesses. Asiana Airlines, Inc. was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Seoul, South Korea. Asiana Airlines, Inc. is a subsidiary of Korean Airlines Co.,Ltd.
